scientific_integrity: The displayed proofs establish arbitrary-field classification using elementary truncated-polynomial valuations; finite-field matrix computations corroborate selected cases but are not infinite proofs. The already established single-operator components and counts are explicitly excluded from originality. Full text of Yao 2015 could not be inspected; priority remains provisional. No independent external audit was performed.
scientific_limitations: Ordinary derivations of one-variable truncated polynomial algebras in characteristic two only; square-zero and pairwise commuting tuples; reduced varieties and finite-field labeled point/rank counts only; no nonreduced equations, higher nilpotence or conjugacy orbits.
title: Joint rank spectra of commuting square-zero derivations on truncated polynomial algebras
